name: Saza (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Saza town emblem in blue: two interlocking rings with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Saza, a town in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 April 1976.

features.role: Saza town emblem — two interlocking rings with a stylised character
